headline: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody Suffers Client Data Breach
summary: Standard Chartered's crypto custodian, Zodia Custody, suffered a data breach exposing client and employee contact information, though no unauthorized transactions occurred.
why: Cybersecurity incidents at institutional crypto custodians raise concerns over operational risk and data protection in digital asset services.

impacts.name: Standard Chartered
impacts.why: A security breach at a subsidiary highlights operational risks that could impact parent company reputation.
